english.title: Vehicle defect - cause the use of a passenger vehicle fitted with tyres with insufficient tread

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a passenger vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), constructed or adapted to carry no more than eight seated passengers in addition to the driver, when the grooves of the tread pattern of a tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL LOCATION..) wheel of the vehicle were not of a depth of at least 1.6 mm throughout a continuous band comprising the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(1)(g) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) For vehicles which require a minimum tread depth of 1mm (i.e. larger goods and passenger vehicles) see charge headings: H154, H158 and H160.
(ii) This offence wording does not apply to motor cycles
(iii) Use this offence wording for motor cars.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H149 and H151.
(v) See also H422, H423 and H424 in relation to goods vehicles.
(vi) See also H425, H426 and H427 in relation to light trailers.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was a passenger vehicle constructed to carry no more than eight seated passengers plus the driver on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The grooves in the tread pattern of the tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL..) wheel of the vehicle were less than 1.6 mm deep throughout a continuous band situated in the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Diffyg ar gerbyd - achosi i gerbyd ar gyfer teithwyr gael ei ddefnyddio a hwnnw gyda theiars â gwadn annigonol
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi achosi i **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) ddefnyddio ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), gerbyd ar gyfer teithwyr, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), a oedd wedi'i adeiladu neu ei addasu i gludo dim mwy nag wyth teithiwr yn eistedd ynghyd â'r gyrrwr, pan nad oedd rhychau patrwm gwadn teiar a oedd wedi'i ffitio i olwyn **(..SPECIFY WHEEL LOCATION..) y cerbyd o leiaf 1.6 mm o ddyfnder mewn band di-dor yn cynnwys tri chwarter canol lled y gwadn ac o gwmpas holl gylchedd allanol y teiar
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) bu i'r diffynnydd achosi i **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) ddefnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) sef cerbyd ar gyfer teithwyr a oedd wedi'i adeiladu i gludo dim mwy nag wyth teithiwr yn eistedd ynghyd â'r gyrrwr ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Roedd y rhychau ym mhatrwm gwadn y teiar a oedd wedi'i ffitio i olwyn **(..SPECIFY WHEEL..) y cerbyd yn llai na 1.6mm o ddyfnder mewn band di-dor yn nhri chwarter canol lled y gwadn ac o gwmpas holl gylchyn allanol y teiar.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 27(4) Rheoliadau Cerbydau Ffyrdd (Gwneuthuriad a Defnydd) 1986, Adran 41A Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.

other.penalty:

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
